title: Aoyagi Toya — Profile Story

rows.Line: Weekend Garage
Weekend Garage Stage

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. You want us to practice talking with the audience...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I do need some practice. I tend to rely on you and Shiraishi quite a bit when it comes to that, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm Toya Aoyagi from Vivid BAD SQUAD. It's nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, um... I think I'm stuck...
I don't know what to talk about...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Just talk about myself and how I'm feeling? Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ever since I was little, I'd been learning how to play classical music on the piano and violin.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, to be more precise...
My father, a professional musician and composer, made me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: At some point, I began to feel all this tension and pain build up inside of me. I'd ultimately end up not playing any longer, but now I'm glad I went through all that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because that experience led to me meeting this team. Not only that, I've been able to make real contributions.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They've even helped me see and experience a wide variety of new things, including meeting many of the people in this city.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I cherish all of those memories.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I know I sound a bit all over the place...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Anyway, what I want to say is...
I realized something while singing and making my own songs here...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The pain I felt back then has given me the power to keep moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, I won't run from whatever hardships we're going to face. We'll overcome everything we have to and surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And we're going to go somewhere no one has gone before.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, thank you for coming to see us today. I hope you enjoy the show.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's it for me...
Did I do alright?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay...
That's good to hear.
